title: Write the launch-day search runbook: submit the sitemap to Google Search Console and Bing, claim the Google Business Profile, and check the town pages

source.ref: SCAN-1227 (2026-11-16): the old plan carried the sitemap submission as a one-line manual step and no local-SEO phase.

detail: Add a section to docs/RUNBOOKS.md that lists, in order: verify the production domain in Google Search Console and Bing Webmaster, submit /sitemap.xml to both, confirm the IndexNow cron (app/api/cron/indexnow) is pinging, claim and fill the Google Business Profile, and spot-check the town pages and llms.txt render and are in the sitemap. The submissions themselves need Daniel's accounts; the runbook is the part a build thread can write.

verify.note: Passes once the runbook section exists.
